name: spawn
algorithm: Start n lightweight tasks in one scope, each adding its index to one atomic counter, and join them all; rounds times (README.md).

skip.c: no std tasks in C (threads only; 1 M OS threads cannot be created on Windows, B19)
skip.rust: no std tasks in Rust (std::thread is OS threads; 1 M cannot be created on Windows, B19)
skip.zig: no std tasks in Zig (std.Thread is OS threads; 1 M cannot be created on Windows, B19)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the atomic sum, which stays below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: the checksum, the sum of every task's index, shows that every task ran once
notes: Concurrency row (B19): both columns run on logical CPUs 0 to 7 (mask 0xff) with 8 threads (MK_CARRIERS=8, GOMAXPROCS=8).
